issues.description: The Bitmap24::resize_buffer method has a parameter type mismatch between its declaration in the template header and its definition in the template implementation, which will cause a compilation error. In the template repository the Bitmap24.hpp declaration uses 'long i_width, long i_height' but the Bitmap24.cpp definition uses 'int i_width, int i_height'. The solution repository uses 'int' consistently in both header and implementation. Because the assignment requires the project to compile to be graded, this mismatch in the template is a blocking structural issue for students.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the declaration and the definition use the same parameter types. Update the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) to 'void resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height);' so it matches the implementation (Bitmap24.cpp) and the solution. Alternatively, change the implementation to take 'long' — but prefer changing the header to 'int' to match the solution and avoid surprising type-width differences.
